page: Microsoft Azure E64nds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance based on the x86_64 architecture and powered by an Intel processor. Operating on Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization, the instance provides 64 dedicated vCPUs with no hardware graphics acceleration units.

The hardware configuration features 512.0 GB of system memory, providing an 8.0 GB per vCPU allocation ratio. Storage facilities include 3780 GB of local NVMe SSD disk space along with support for Premium Storage. The instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 networking addresses.

The combination of high memory capacity and substantial direct-attached NVMe storage supports dense resource consolidation. Because local NVMe disks provide transient storage, systems requiring permanent persistence must configure external storage. This configuration fits enterprise relational databases, large-scale in-memory caches, search engines, and data analytics workloads requiring extensive memory and fast scratch disk I/O.
